 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Lisentious"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Licentious". (लुच्चा)
 
 
• **Example: **His licentious behavior caused a lot of trouble at the event.
 
 
 
• **"Licentious"** refers to someone who is morally unrestrained or disregards accepted rules and standards. (लुच्चा)
 
 
• **Example: **The novel was criticized for its licentious content.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Maxim** (सूक्ति): A short, pithy statement expressing a general truth or rule of conduct.
 
 
• **Example:** "Honesty is the best policy" is a well-known maxim.
 
 
 
• **Profligate** (अपव्ययी): Recklessly extravagant or wasteful in the use of resources.
 
 
• **Example: **His profligate spending habits led him into debt.
 
 
 
• **Quandary** (दुविधा): A state of perplexity or uncertainty over what to do in a difficult situation.
 
 
• **Example:** She was in a quandary about whether to accept the job offer.
